TWO REMAINING MATERIAL DEFECTS:
1. DURABLE ORDER-INTENT AUDIT DROPS reduce_only. `append_order_intent()` puts planner `reduce_only` into its in-memory row, but `ORDER_INTENT_FIELDS` does not include `reduce_only`; `append_csv()` filters every row to the declared field list. Therefore `order_intents.csv` silently loses planner reduce_only. This violates the G2 requirement that planner side/reduce_only propagate through the durable audit surface.
2. DURABLE LIVE-FILL AUDIT USES LEADER SIDE. `append_live_fill()` writes `side: fill.side`, which is the leader event side, not necessarily the planner-authorised follower order side. In sign-flip/opposite-direction cases the durable follower fill audit can therefore record the wrong side.
